text:
deploy-bot: initiating config-only change: region weight shift + batch cap reduction. Canary 5% for 20m -> progressive to 30% if metrics stable. Change window 18:30-20:30 UTC. Diff: weight(eu-west-1)=+15%, weight(us-central)= -10%, batch_max_tokens=24, max_concurrency_per_router=6, overall request_timeout_ms=1600. Will post health summaries every 4m.

jess: why are we lowering request timeout to 1600ms? worried about client timeouts for long prompts.

rafi: lowering timeout reduces stuck in-flight tails; most production prompts are <1200ms after recent kvcache patch. We should exclude enterprise_x and tenant-loadtest from canary to be safe.

diane: agreed exclude enterprise_x. Also add autoscaler policy: immediate drain on OOM, mark node unhealthy for 10m.

ops-bot: noted: exclusion list updated -> ["enterprise_x","tenant-loadtest"]. Autoscaler policy applied.

jess: add rollback guard: abort if p95 rises by >200ms from baseline or total_error_rate +1.5% absolute. Also abort if infra OOMs > 2 hosts in 15m.

rafi: telemetry slice we will watch: per-region p50/p95/p99, error_rate, kv_cache_miss, shard_queue_length. If any region breaches, we stop bump.

jess: small ops snippet for records:

```yaml
change: config-only
canary:
  initial_pct: 5
  step_up: [15,30]
  step_duration_min: 20
routing_weights:
  eu-west-1: +15
  us-central-1: -10
batching:
  max_tokens: 24
  per_router_concurrency: 6
timeouts_ms: 1600
exclusions: [enterprise_x, tenant-loadtest]
autoscaler:
  oom_drain: true
  unhealthy_ttl_min: 10
rollback_triggers:
  p95_delta_ms: 200
  error_rate_abs_pct: 1.5
  infra_oom_hosts_15m: 2
```

deploy-bot: canary started at 2026-05-11T18:31:39Z. Observability links: /dash/route-weights, /dash/batch-health. Paging on alerts to @rafi and @diane.

(4m) ops-bot: health summary: eu p50 70ms p95 420ms p99 980ms, us p95 460ms, error_rate delta +0.3%, kv_cache_miss +0.6%. All within guardrails.

(13m) jess: spotted slight increase in shard_queue_length on one eu router. autoscaler drained the host; routed traffic rebalanced. No client errors seen.

(20m) rafi: green to step to 15%. Holding next check at +20min then to 30% if stable.

diane: publishing release note draft: "Config-only: adjusted routing weights to favor eu-west-1 for latency optimization, reduced batch_max_tokens to 24 and lowered request timeout to 1600ms. Canary rollout 5% -> 15% -> 30% on green checks. Exclusions: enterprise_x, tenant-loadtest. Rollback if p95 increases >200ms, error rate +1.5%, or >2 infra OOMs in 15m. Autoscaler drain enabled."

jess: I'll stay oncall for the latter half of the change window. Ping me on any p95 > 500ms in eu.

deploy-bot: next automated post in 4m with perf traces and sample slow requests. Commands: `/deploybot abort-config` to revert, `/deploybot list-pins` (no model pins changed in this rollout).
